answer.reason: The verse says the word of the LORD came to Zephaniah, which is an event beyond the summary's relations and office.

clauses.english: received the word of the LORD in the days of Josiah
clauses.quote: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah

doubts: The verses given only state that the word came to him; the content of the prophecy (1:2-3) is spoken by the LORD and not narrated as Zephaniah's deed.
